task.title: Say hi and match
task.shortdesc: You match with someone when you both say hi. Until then, neither of you can chat.

step.cmd: On the Nearby tab, tap Say hi on the person's card.
step.stepresult: The Say hi to name sheet shows the interests you both like.
The button on their card changes to Hi sent, and they get a notification: name says hi.

result.p: If they tap Say hi back, you match. You both get You matched with name, and the Match screen opens by itself. If they tap Not now, you aren't told.

tasktroubleshooting.p: A hi expires after 15 minutes. If they don't answer in time, you see Couldn't reach name right now. You can say hi to the same person once a day, to up to 10 people an hour, and to up to 30 people a day.

example.title: When someone says hi to you
example.p: A sheet shows name says hi and their note. Tap Say hi back to match, or Not now to pass; they won't be told, and a hi from them is ignored for 7 days. The same sheet has Report and Block.
